body:
## Summary

- Change Sepo's built-in Claude model default from the date/version-pinned Claude Code ID `claude-opus-4-8` to the ACP-advertised `opus` alias.
- Update the provider resolver regression test and Sepo docs/changelog to match.

## Why

Follow-up implementation runs fork/resume the prior answer session. On that resume path, acpx validates requested models against the Claude ACP adapter's advertised model IDs before prompting. In CI the resumed session advertises `default`, `opus`, and `haiku`, so the old default `claude-opus-4-8` caused `/implement` to fail before the agent could run.

Using `opus` keeps the default on the ACP-native model identifier and avoids relying on Claude Code fresh-session `_meta.claudeCode.options.model` behavior.

## Test plan

- `cd .agent && npm test`
- Manual resolver check: `DEFAULT_PROVIDER=claude ROUTE=implement GITHUB_OUTPUT=$(mktemp) node .github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.js` outputs `model=opus`.

Fixes the model-selection failure observed on issue #71 follow-up implementation runs.
